label: Chapter 03

sentences.en: The important thing for you to remember is that it does not matter in the least how you got the idea into your mind initially, or where it came from.
sentences.zh: 你要记住的重要一点是，这个想法最初是怎么进入你脑海的、又是从哪里来的，一点都不重要。

sentences.en: The important thing is that somehow, somewhere along the line, you believe it.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，不知在什么时候、什么地方，你相信了它。

sentences.en: You act upon it.
sentences.zh: 你按照它去行动。

sentences.en: And it is this belief, acted upon, that becomes the reality that you deal with, and that is only what is real to you.
sentences.zh: 而正是这个被付诸行动的信念，变成了你要面对的现实，也成了对你而言唯一真实的东西。

sentences.en: – Maxwell Maltz
sentences.zh: ——麦克斯韦·马尔茨

sentences.en: Here's how you've become who you are today, and how you will become who you will be tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 下面讲讲你是如何成为今天的自己的，以及你明天将如何成为未来的自己。

sentences.en: This is the anatomy of identity:
sentences.zh: 这就是身份认同的构成：

sentences.en: You want to achieve a goal
sentences.zh: 你想实现一个目标

sentences.en: You perceive reality through the lens of that goal
sentences.zh: 你透过这个目标的视角来感知现实

sentences.en: You only notice "important" information and ideas that allows you to achieve that goal (learning)
sentences.zh: 你只注意到那些能帮你实现这个目标的“重要”信息和想法（学习）

sentences.en: You act toward that goal and receive feedback that you are progressing toward it
sentences.zh: 你朝着这个目标行动，并得到反馈，知道自己正在向它靠近

sentences.en: You repeat that behavior until it becomes automatic and unconscious (conditioning)
sentences.zh: 你重复这种行为，直到它变得自动化、无意识（条件作用）

sentences.en: That behavior becomes a part of who you think you are ("I am the type of person who...")
sentences.zh: 这种行为成为你认为的自我的一部分（“我是那种……的人”）

sentences.en: You defend your identity to maintain psychological consistency
sentences.zh: 你捍卫自己的身份认同，以维持心理上的一致性

sentences.en: Your identity shapes new goals, restarting the cycle, and if that identity is disadvantageous toward a good life, this gets bad very quick
sentences.zh: 你的身份认同又塑造了新的目标，循环重新开始；如果这种身份认同不利于过上好生活，情况会很快变得很糟

sentences.en: The unfortunate reality is that you must break the cycle between steps 6 and 7, but this process starts when you are a child.
sentences.zh: 不幸的现实是，你必须在第 6 步和第 7 步之间打破这个循环，但这个过程从你还是个孩子时就开始了。

sentences.en: You have the goal of survival.
sentences.zh: 你的目标是生存。

sentences.en: You are dependent on your parents to teach you how to survive.
sentences.zh: 你依赖父母教你如何生存。

sentences.en: You had to conform.
sentences.zh: 你不得不顺从。

sentences.en: And since the way you act is more important than how you think, you learn to act in a way that your parents approve of, and you give them ideas that you may not believe.
sentences.zh: 而且，由于你的行为方式比你的想法更重要，你学会了以父母认可的方式行事，并向他们表达一些你自己未必相信的想法。

sentences.en: But your parents have also gone through this process throughout their entire lives.
sentences.zh: 但你的父母一生也经历过同样的过程。

sentences.en: That's where it gets messy.
sentences.zh: 问题就出在这里，事情变得复杂了。

sentences.en: Because the way they teach you to survive is based on their own survival – the ideas and behaviors they were taught as children.
sentences.zh: 因为他们教你生存的方式，是建立在他们自己的生存经验之上的——也就是他们小时候被灌输的那些想法和行为。

sentences.en: To take it a layer deeper, once you fulfill your physical survival needs (which is quite easy to do in the modern world), you seek psychological survival.
sentences.zh: 再深入一层，一旦你满足了身体上的生存需求（在现代世界里，这其实相当容易），你就会寻求心理上的生存。

sentences.en: You seek an identity that stands up to social scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 你会寻求一个能经得起社会审视的身份认同。

sentences.en: A new goal.
sentences.zh: 一个新的目标。

sentences.en: One that is no different than your parents.
sentences.zh: 一个和你父母的目标没什么不同的目标。

sentences.en: And the process just repeats.
sentences.zh: 于是这个过程只是不断重复。

sentences.en: Until it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 直到它不再重复为止。

sentences.en: When your body feels threatened, you go into fight or flight.
sentences.zh: 当你的身体感到受到威胁时，你会进入战斗或逃跑状态。

sentences.en: When your identity feels threatened, the same thing happens.
sentences.zh: 当你的身份认同感到受到威胁时，同样会发生这种事。

sentences.en: If you are heavily identified with a political ideology (by the process we talked about just before) and somebody makes an argument against it, you will get defensive and attack their character.
sentences.zh: 如果你与某种政治意识形态深度认同（通过我们刚才谈到的那个过程），而有人提出反对它的论点，你就会变得防御性十足，并攻击对方的人格。

sentences.en: If you were raised in a religious household, and did not think for yourself, you will fight and attack their character for that same reason.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在一个宗教家庭长大的，而且没有独立思考，你也会出于同样的原因去争斗、攻击对方的人格。

sentences.en: The same thing happens when you unconsciously see yourself as a lawyer, a gamer, or somebody else who you believe is intrinsically worthy of respect.
sentences.zh: 当你无意识地把自己看作一名律师、一名游戏玩家，或其他某个你认为天生就值得尊敬的人时，同样会发生这种事。

sentences.en: You defend this identity because, freakishly, your survival depends on it.
sentences.zh: 你捍卫这种身份认同，是因为——奇怪的是——你的生存依赖于它。

title_en: III – You aren't where you want to be because you're afraid to be there
title_zh: 三、你不在你想去的地方，是因为你害怕到那里

vocab.example_en: The course covers the anatomy of the human heart.
Children perceive the world differently from adults.
Regular exercise is a form of physical conditioning.
The company's accounts came under close scrutiny.
New students are expected to conform to the school rules.
